info.name: AppDynamics Alert and Respond Actions Business Transactions API
List business transactions for an application

params.name: applicationId
params.description: The numeric ID or name of the business application.

params.name: output
params.description: The output format for the response. Defaults to XML if not specified.

items.docs: Returns all business transactions for the specified application including transaction names, IDs, entry point types, and tier associations.
